definitions.point: A position with no length, width, or thickness.
definitions.line: A straight path extending without end in both directions.
definitions.plane: A flat surface extending indefinitely in two dimensions.
definitions.segment: Part of a line bounded by two endpoints.
definitions.ray: Part of a line with one endpoint extending without end.
definitions.angle: Two rays meeting at a common endpoint called the vertex.
definitions.conjecture: A proposed mathematical statement requiring proof.
definitions.counterexample: An example disproving a universal claim.
definitions.theorem: A mathematical statement established by proof.
definitions.proof: A chain of justified statements establishing a mathematical conclusion.
